name: External Framework Round-Trip Rollout
purpose: Apply the existing MIR-proven external-framework request/response pattern to one registry-selected external framework without creating framework-specific transport, custody, scheduler, execution, credential, or user-verification authority.
trigger: a consuming Goal Task requests an admissibility-wiki external framework to participate in a governed StegVerse round trip
scope: one external-framework registry entry, one bounded manifested request, one governed request/response cycle, and one exact evidence/custody lineage
reuse_instructions: Resolve exactly one external-framework entry from the canonical admissibility-wiki registry. Reuse the existing external-adapter and RTC component contracts. If an authentic reachable runtime endpoint or required official artifact is unavailable, emit the exact fail-closed eligibility state and stop that invocation without creating substitute transport or blocking unrelated framework invocations. Do not mint per-framework WorkerCoordinator, Interlock/InTr, SDK-return, custody, publisher, credential, scheduler, or user-verification implementations. Source/CI/merge state never upgrades authentic runtime predicates.
